editorial.description: A cityscape tutorial starts by bringing imagined nature into an office-bound city, tears through a fence, builds dense Hong Kong–New York–San Francisco–Los Angeles geometry, adds a nighttime doorway and ends by questioning how long a painting really took.
editorial.summary: A cityscape tutorial starts by bringing imagined nature into an office-bound city, tears through a fence, builds dense Hong Kong–New York–San Francisco–Los Angeles geometry, adds a nighttime doorway and ends by questioning how long a painting really took. This is an official-channel creative lesson or reflection, not clinical treatment or a universal formula. Its chronological map follows the route's own transcript and distinguishes art-making instructions from autobiographical claims, jokes and metaphors. Visually dependent technique still requires the source video.

The video treats revision, imperfection and emotional attention as more important than copying a polished Choe image.

publication_restrictions.rule: Do not present mental-health, addiction or trauma metaphors as diagnosis or treatment; preserve them as the artist’s framing.
